name: Virginia Sheet Metal
old_description: Our metal shop specializes in custom-made chimney chase covers, crafted from high-quality materials such as stainless steel, aluminum, copper, galvanized steel, and painted metals. These durable covers are designed to provide a perfect fit, protecting chimney chases from water, debris, and animals.
about:
Virginia Sheet Metal operates from Newport News, Virginia, serving the Hampton Roads region with custom sheet metal and ductwork fabrication. The company focuses on supplying HVAC professionals with components built to exact specifications.

The shop produces a range of HVAC components including chimney chase covers, drain pans, custom ductwork, plenums, and a variety of fittings such as radial elbows, square-to-round transitions, breeches, Y-fittings, Parker fittings, and base boxes. All fabrication is performed in-house using materials such as stainless steel, aluminum, copper, galvanized steel, and painted metals. The company also offers design, fabrication, delivery, and installation services.

Virginia Sheet Metal primarily serves HVAC contractors and companies working on residential and commercial systems. Its customer base includes professionals who require precision-crafted ductwork and fittings for new installations or replacements.

The company emphasizes in-house production to maintain consistent quality and fast turnaround, and it works closely with clients to tailor designs to specific needs. Components are made to exact specifications to ensure easy installation and durability, with a focus on on-time delivery.
